name: Researcher Phase Transition → SYNTHESIZE (dev_via_spec mode)
description: ADR-041 addendum 2026-05-16 §"Synthesize action_allowlist must be mode-aware". Fires when phasevalidator has approved a gather→synthesize transition AND the chain carries chain.mode.classification == "dev_via_spec" (mirrored onto the source-loop entity by the validator alongside the proceed sentinel). The spawned synthesize loop's action_allowlist INCLUDES "architect" — the dev-via-spec arc's canonical forward edge. Sibling 05a handles research_only chains with the architect-excluded allowlist. Legacy chains without chain.mode default to dev_via_spec via the validator's mirror-write so this rule fires.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-synthesize
on_enter.prompt:
SYNTHESIZE phase entry — DEV_VIA_SPEC chain. Source loop $entity.instance (researcher-gather) has handed off with decide(action="synthesize"). Call read_loop_result on that loop to read the gathered evidence in its narrative terminal. Compose the structured research artifact (actors/integration_points/tasks/addressed_gaps/open_gaps) from the evidence per researcher-synthesize/00-identity.md and 10-emit-rules.md. Use scratchpad to draft before the strict-schema emit_research_artifact call.

Terminal options (allow-list enforced by phasevalidator): decide(action="architect") forward to the architect phase (dev-via-spec arc); decide(action="gather") back-edge if synthesis surfaces a corpus gap (bounded by gather cap=3); decide(action="emit") pure-research-arc terminal; decide(action="needs_clarification") when evidence is structurally inconsistent with the plan.

metadata.validator: cmd/semteams/phasevalidator/phase.go (PhaseValidator) writes the chain.mode mirror on the source-loop entity at synthesize-approval time. Rule conditions only read the firing entity's own triples; the mirror is the cross-entity bridge.
metadata.proceed_sentinel: chain.phase_transition.proceed.synthesize on source researcher-gather loop entity
metadata.mode_mirror: chain.mode.classification on source researcher-gather loop entity (mirrored from chain entity by phasevalidator)
metadata.legacy_fallback: Chains dispatched without a coordinator front-door (legacy research-iterative configs, ad-hoc dispatch) carry no chain.mode on the chain entity. The validator's mirror-write defaults to dev_via_spec in that case, so this rule fires and preserves pre-addendum behaviour (architect-allowed allowlist).
metadata.sibling_rule: 05a-phase-transition-to-synthesize-research-only.json — research_only mode excludes architect from the allowlist.
